summary: Super League Enterprise filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, disclosing subscription agreements with Metaplanet Holdings and Evo Fund. The company will issue 44,859,400 common shares at $3.00 per share, strategic preferred stock, and warrants to Metaplanet (up to 381M shares, exercise $3.00-$33.50, 10-year term) and Evo (up to 10M shares, exercise $3.00-$5.55, 2-year term). Metaplanet pays 2,100 Bitcoin valued at market, plus future $210M preferred investment option over 24 months. The transaction is a capital raise, not an acquisition or return to shareholders. Watch for dilution and closing conditions.
